# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly, likely in her late seventies or early eighties  <sub>[v2 c26 P14](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
- **Titles:** Aunt Euphemia  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>; Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunty J.  <sub>[v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Euphemia is a small, elderly woman with a slightly triangular face, rosy cheeks, and large, gentle blue eyes full of youth and expectations. Her silver-white hair is styled in charming small rolls above her ears. She dresses in an outmoded style, which she finds comfortable.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is irrepressibly cheerful, optimistic, and possesses a youthful, sweet nature. She holds a relaxed philosophy on life, choosing not to supervise or burden the young women in her care with strict rules, believing people should enjoy life and fulfill their duties. Though a devout Christian, she possesses a lighthearted sense of humor and candidly reflects on her own quirks and past suitors. She is deeply affectionate toward her housemates and animals, especially cats.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v3 c35 P18](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0018)_

## Traits

- Irrepressibly cheerful and optimistic  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
- Indulgent and non-judgmental toward youth  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
- Lover of cats  <sub>[v3 c35 P18](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0018)</sub>
- Fear of snakes  <sub>[v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003), [v3 c35 P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at fine needlework and knitting  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v3 c35 P18](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To enjoy her life comfortably without worrying over useless details or strict conventions  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>

## History

When Mabel Colby was searching for a housekeeper to manage a home for herself, Nell, Honora, and Cressy in Portmaris, she invited her widowed Aunt Euphemia to take the position. Aunt Euphemia accepted, seeking companionship after her daughter departed for India. Moving into Tabby's Place along with her two cats, Joseph and the Sarah-cat, she quickly won the deep affection of all the girls through her indulgent, sweet-tempered nature. She remained at Tabby's Place to keep the house warm during college vacations while the girls returned to their homes. When the girls completed their university studies, she decided to stay in the home and take care of her cats rather than travel.

_Sources: [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v3 c35 P18](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0018)_

## Background by volume

- Named Jamesina (or Euphemia) after her father James, who drowned at sea before her birth  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
- Had a single daughter who married and moved to India as a missionary  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003)</sub>
- Had numerous suitors in her youth, whom she often laughed at

## Quotes

> If you will ever understand how to conduct yourselves, you are at an age to know it now. Therefore, as it pertains to me, you are all free to ruin yourselves as you see fit.  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>

> A yellow silk dress was something I perpetually desired, yet my mother initially, and later my husband, refused to countenance it. Obtaining a yellow silk dress is the absolute first action I intend to take upon arriving in heaven.  <sub>[v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005)</sub>

> You can be sure I'm going to keep my head held high... even if I might still discuss matters with you as I normally do merely to vent my emotions in the event that the Ashdowns perform further shocking actions.  <sub>[v5 c12 P30](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0030)</sub>
